processing: Monthly anomalies, each series rebased by subtracting its own 36-month mean for 1988–1990. No smoothing, detrending or removal of ENSO, solar variability or QBO. UAH first GLOBAL column used, not its running-mean columns.
interpretation: Observed changes include all influences. Annual 1992 minus 1991 difference is not an attribution estimate.
